verdict.rationale: Reflect has a real OAuth2 REST API with a published OpenAPI spec, but it covers only a small slice of the UI: listing graphs, reading and creating bookmarked links, appending to daily notes, creating notes, and getting the current user. The vendor itself says the API supports "appending data… and a few other things" and cannot serve note contents because they are end-to-end encrypted, so parity with the UI is explicitly not offered. Missing for 10: reading, searching or editing note contents via the API; API access to AI palette, chat, semantic search, filters, note history/revert, publishing, backlinks, import/export, and integrations; versioning/deprecation policy and a sandbox.
